boundaries.name: falcon-a11-signature-validity
boundaries.obligation: validate_all_member_signatures / validate_member_signature_slots and the non-empty sender_hash_sig check are structural (slot/key/blob shape) only; Falcon N-of-N signature validity over the next-state digest, the BabyBear sender hash-sig proof and the A11 two-key membership binding are discharged by the wallet acceptance path and the close circuit, never by this file or the model.

boundaries.name: durable-replay-ledger-and-root-freshness
boundaries.obligation: ensure_different_root only proves the nullifier root changed (unequal_root_is_only_inequality); neither the source nor the model verifies a valid nullifier-tree insertion, uniqueness of the inserted nullifier, or a durable signer/replay ledger across transitions. Root inequality must not be read as freshness.

boundaries.name: l1-backing-and-finality
boundaries.obligation: L1 deposit backing (verify_channel_backing / receive_deposit proof), base-layer transfer finality, source/destination channel agreement and the burn escrow are external premises; the deposit and fund-import verifiers only check local arithmetic and digests.

boundaries.name: accumulator-frontier
boundaries.obligation: require_accumulator_push is defined here but never invoked by any witness verify; the settled-tx accumulator insertion for sends/imports is checked by the wallet co-signer with the persisted IncrementalMerkleTree. The model treats push/get_root as opaque callbacks and does not supply the frontier.

boundaries.name: keccak-and-digest-helpers
boundaries.obligation: solidity_keccak256, ChannelState::signing_digest, BalanceState::h1, ChannelTx::signing_digest, InterChannelTx::{signing_digest,tx_leaf_hash,compute_tx_hash}, burn_descriptor, l1_deposit_import_digest, RegevCiphertext::digest, regev_pk_root and settled_tx_chain_push are opaque Environment callbacks; collision resistance / injectivity of every digest is assumed, not proved.

boundaries.name: regev-stark-and-transport-proof-soundness
boundaries.obligation: RegevProofVerifier (E-1 ChannelTx, E-2 ChannelUpdate, BalanceRefresh) and ChannelProofVerifier (Plonky2 intmax transport) are opaque callbacks; only the envelope role/backend gate and the exact rebuilt statement/PI are modeled. Soundness of the STARK/SNARK and correct wiring of the statement inside the prover are premises.

boundaries.name: balance-record-validation-and-canonical-builders
boundaries.obligation: BalanceState::validate (canonical ciphertexts, D3 budgets, active-registry injectivity), RegevPk::validate, add_ciphertexts, decrypt_amount, BalanceState::verify_token_register_transition and token_register_next_state are opaque; resolve_token_slot uniqueness relies on validate() having run, which the model does not re-derive.

boundaries.name: native-integer-profile-and-host
boundaries.obligation: u64 `+ 1` on epoch/state_version wraps in release and panics under overflow-checks (modeled by OverflowMode, neither profile is pinned); U256 `+` panics on final carry; direct array indexing (enc_balances[i][t], pending_adds[i][t], member_pk_gs[depositor_slot]) panics out of range; usize is taken as 64-bit. Panic vs Err is distinguished in the model but the host panic strategy, allocation failure and serde are not modeled.

boundaries.name: gate-compiler-and-source-refinement
boundaries.obligation: The Lean definitions are a handwritten translation of the Rust control flow; no rustc/MIR refinement, no plonky2/plonky3 gate lowering, and no equivalence between these native checks and any in-circuit statement is proved. Exact error strings and check ordering inside opaque callees are not modeled.

boundaries.name: cross-channel-authorization
boundaries.obligation: All-cluster consistency inside one channel does not authorize anything about a different channel: destination_recipient_pk, source_sender_pk and the off-chain sender before/after ciphertexts are taken as claimed; their authenticity is the other channel's regev_pk_root / STARK-transcript concern.
